title: Law to create new HPD rental assistance voucher program
summary: This bill would establish a new city rental assistance voucher program, administered by the Department of Housing Preservation and Development and subject to budget appropriation, for households earning up to 50% of area median income who face eviction, live in certain shelters, or are otherwise at risk of homelessness. It also amends existing law to remove unimplemented provisions of Local Laws 99-102 of 2023 and to codify how tenant rent contributions are calculated, including utility allowances. The program would begin accepting applications within 180 days of enactment, with HPD required to report annually starting August 1, 2027.
